verdict.rationale: GitHub docs confirm a dedicated Copilot CLI exists and that cloud agents can be run automatically on a schedule or via repo events (Automations), supporting non-interactive automation use cases, and cloud/local sandboxes provide isolated execution for such runs. However, there is no explicit documentation of a headless/non-interactive scripting mode with CLI flags, exit codes, or CI pipeline examples, nor independent hands-on confirmation of scripted automation. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive CLI flags/exit-code behavior, CI/CD pipeline examples, and independent verification of scripted usage.
